facts.title: Thai Curried Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons coconut oil or olive oil
2 pound butternut or kabocha squash, peeled, seeded, and cut into small ½-inch pieces (about 3 cups)
2 to 3 tablespoons Thai red curry paste*
⅛ teaspoon red pepper flakes (up to ¼ teaspoon for spicier soup)
½ cup full fat coconut milk for drizzling on top
½ cup large, unsweetened coconut flakes**
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
